title: view form: layout horizontal is stored and served, but the label stays above the input
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ① declared but not honoured (ADR-0049). Filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29672 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix · acceptance[1]
Reader: `domain:ui` (the form renderer).
Dedupe: `form layout horizontal`. The checklist's `knownGaps[0]` records it from QA run #26715, which has no card of its own. **New as a card.**
type: Bug

Runner reading on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`, on two fresh loads, not re-derived by the PM seat. `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/qa_doc.k1?mode=draft&package=PKG` with `config.layout: 'horizontal'`, publish, open `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces?surface=view%3Aqa_doc.k1`, Design and Run. Expected: the label beside the input. Actual: label at (257,209), input at (257,226), stacked. Read on the Studio surface only, not on the end-user form.

Studio's form-view inspector now offers Layout, so a person can pick this and see nothing change. Wanted: honour it, or retire the value (enforce-or-remove).

Links back: #29672, #26715.
